description:

Darren breaks the Hak5 lineup into three main categories: hot-plug attack tools, pen-test implants, and near-access Wi-Fi testing tools. He explains how these devices are designed to emulate real-world attacks so defenders can understand how an organization could be compromised and what needs to be fixed.
